meta.title: KabadiWala — Collect e-waste, sell to authorized recyclers
meta.description: Photograph e-waste, weigh it, get a transparent estimate, quotes from nearby authorized recyclers, and QR-verified handover with immediate payment.

hero.title: Fair value for e-waste, minus the guesswork
hero.subtitle: Photograph your lot, weigh it, get a transparent estimate, and close the deal with a QR-verified handover to a nearby authorized recycler.
hero.screenAlt: Illustration of the KabadiWala app estimate screen

steps.title: Weight
steps.desc: Weigh it and get an instant estimate.

steps.title: Quotes
steps.desc: Receive rates from nearby authorized recyclers.

steps.title: Handover & pay
steps.desc: Hand over via QR code and get paid.

collector.title: For collectors
benefits: Clear, instant estimate on every lot
Authorized recyclers and their rates in your area

recycler.title: For recyclers
benefits: Set your own rates and quote lots
Ready lots with photo and weight attached

trust.title: Trust and safety
trust.subtitle: Every deal stays transparent behind the scenes.

items.title: Authorized recyclers
items.desc: Recyclers provide an authorization number (PCC) at onboarding, shown in the app.

items.title: Safe handling
items.desc: Safety guidance for batteries, CRTs and other risky parts is built into the app.

items.title: QR-verified payment trail
items.desc: Every handover has a QR-verified code and reference ID on which the receipt is generated.
